findings.F1: Across every 84-bar grid point of every coin (about 1,500 cases), the ratio of the coin's 7-day (42-bar) volatility to its 90-day (540-bar) volatility predicts its excess return over the next 14 days. The Spearman rho with strength is 0.139 (p = 7e-8). The top volatility-ratio quintile averages +0.166 of a usual 14-day move (t 3.19, n 300) and the fourth quintile +0.131 (t 2.18), against −0.048, −0.092 and −0.058 for the three lowest. The rho is positive in 18 of the 19 coins (share 0.947).
findings.F2: The volatility-ratio effect sits in coins whose prior 14-day return is positive. There, the top quintile averages +0.232 of a usual move (t 3.11, n 168) and the bottom quintile −0.172 (t −2.15, n 155), a clean progression of −0.17, −0.06, −0.08, +0.18, +0.23. After a negative 14-day return the quintiles are flat and mixed (+0.086, −0.126, −0.042, +0.093, +0.081, no |t| above 1.9).
findings.F3: The effect is not steady by year. The top volatility-ratio quintile scores +0.50 in 2023 and +0.43 in 2024, but −0.15 in 2021, −0.38 in 2025 and −0.35 in 2018.
findings.F4: The panic premium the backtest captures comes from up-moving wide-range stretches, not falls. When a coin's 24-hour range is at least 7.5 mean bar ranges and it rose over those 24 hours, the next 84 bars beat the drift by +7.58 % (strength 0.263, t 3.37, 369 cases). The same stretches with a fall gain only +1.40 % (strength 0.063, t 1.33, 284 cases).
findings.F5: The rising-stretch premium is not graded by the move's size. Its Spearman rho with the 14-day excess is 0.003 for the 24h scaled move and −0.055 for the range ratio. By 24h-move quintile, the fourth (+4.6 usual moves) earns +10.9 % (t 2.74) and the fifth (+7.2) only +2.7 % (t 1.22). The premium also reverses in 2018 (−0.58 of a usual move, t −2.25) and 2022 (−0.49, t −3.53).
findings.F6: The tested combination, a fall in a coin with a positive 90-day return, is thin and flat at −0.97 % excess (t −0.33, 25 cases). Most wide-range stretches lack 540 bars of history inside their window: 538 of 653 cases have no 90-day reading.
findings.F7: The book's 537 trades earn +7.84 % net on average (64 % winners, median 14 days held). Its mean daily return runs from −0.018 % in 2018 to +0.125 % in 2024, following the same years as F3 and F5.

ideas.idea: The more a coin's volatility over the last 7 days exceeds its volatility over the last 90 days, the higher its return over the next 14 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader leans long a coin whose recent volatility has expanded well beyond its 90-day norm, and refuses longs in coins whose volatility has gone quiet.
ideas.name: volatility expansion precedes gains

ideas.idea: While a coin's 14-day return is positive, the more its volatility over the last 7 days exceeds its volatility over the last 90 days, the higher its return over the next 14 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader buys a rising coin whose volatility is expanding and refuses a rising coin whose volatility is contracting, where the next two weeks tend to lag.
ideas.name: expanding volatility in uptrends
